params._merge_why: fragments whose gap <= 1 km form one slick event = Cerulean 500 m closing buffer (SkyTruth cerulean-cloud constants INFRA/DARK_CLOSING_BUFFER); fragment merging needed (KSAT: ~100 polygons/event, Bianchi et al. 2020)
params._min_area_why: 64 px at the E005 x2 grid (17.8 x 19.9 m = 354 m2): E005 VAL misses 73% of GT components <= 64 px (EXPERIMENT_LOG E005), so smaller detections are below the detector's reliable size
params._wind_why: C-band oil detectability window: ~2-3 m/s lower (look-alike regime below), ~10 m/s upper (Topouzelis 2008 Sensors 8:6642; Fingas & Brown 2018 Sensors 18:91)

notes.ais_coverage_caveat: AIS extract region was cut around the reference slick when the dataset was built; scene-wide autonomy needs a scene-wide AIS extract
